dog.description_text: Hi, my name is Barry, but my foster mom likes to call me Betty. I’m 3-5 months old, weigh 6 pounds, and am as cute as can be! I arrived in NYC from Georgia on September 16, 2026. I’m currently living in Manhattan with my foster mom, my foster sisters, Briana and Sophie, and Angus, my four-legged foster brother, in an apartment. I love spending my days sleeping, eating, and playing. I’m a super-chill pup, and I use my pee pad when I need to go to the bathroom. I enjoy treats of all kinds and love playing with my toys. I also enjoy going on walks with my foster brother, Angus. I’m so brave that I've taken the bus multiple times with my foster mom in my sling bag to explore NYC. I’m currently looking for my forever home!
dog.name: Barry
